name: aico
description: AI companion with a browser and phone view, all over Tether-owned tmux sessions.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace tether && npm run build --workspace web/server && npm run build --workspace web/frontend
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspace tether && tsc --noEmit -p web/server && tsc --noEmit -p web/frontend
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
